name: smwgraphics-new-redrawn-overworld-mario-and-luigi-sprites
title: New Redrawn Overworld Mario and Luigi Sprites
description:
Alternatives to the default icegoom Redrawn Mario overworld sprite graphic as I found that to be generally unreadable. So I made my own in 2019, tho I did some touch-ups since then.

Extract this for your GFX10 file to use.

Note that this is designed for a single-player hack. As such, there is a file for having Mario as the player, and another for having Luigi as the player.

This is designed to be used with the overworld sprites from icegoom's Redrawn SMW graphics hack, which can be found here: https://www.smwcentral.net/?a=details&id=5914&p=section
